text.text_excerpt: One of the many tropical Isles along Bourbon Street. The bathroom is super accessible in this place and the famous drink you should go with is the hand grenade which they also have in a skinny version. These bad boys will set you back $10 a piece but they are strong and go down ow so smoothly. The service here is quick and friendly. And I believe they had an upstairs balcony if I'm not mistaken but we didn't Venture up there we just got our drinks and then went back out to Bourbon Street to pet the police horse lol!

Always go here for the obligatory Hand Grenade on Bourbon Street! Tasty drink...and doesn't taste as strong as it feels!! Decent live music too, from what I've heard. They also serve the Horny Gator, which my husband tried. Tasted good, but not as good as the Hand Grenade!

I love this place for the cajun / zydeco / creole music - about the only place in the French Quarter where it can be heard authentically. It's a really fun place to dance too. Don't worry if you can't dance well; just give it a try. The bar service is good. The wait staff is also good - ask for Elizabeth: she's the best.
